info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Interior Design

description.describe_ch: 人們的生活環境與大自然的關係是永遠不可分割的.人離開了大自然就無法生存.為了考慮到建築環境之間的協調和平衡,其中包括了自然環境之基本要素例如:熱,光,音,水,空氣等.本課程提出很多參考實例,對於設計會有很大的助益.
description.describe_eh: Human environment is substantially indivisible with the nature. In case that no mercy is brought by the nature, then no environment will satisfy people's lives. We should have a pure mind encouraging us to make our efforts in getting rid of artificial operation and return to the nature. In consideration of the harmonious and balancing relation between the architectural environment, which is comprised of heat, light, sound, water and air that are the essential element, we have this course stressing on the instructions and explanation in detail for all points from the basic theories to practical application examples, exactly able to offer a great help for design.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1.	準時出席
        準時上課，若需請假應事先告知。積極熟悉使用課堂線上工具平台，充分表達參與度與自己觀點看法。
2.	專心參與
        教室內禁止飲食用餐，避免影響他人，上課請專注聽講與參與課堂活動討論。 
3.	作業與報告
        準時參與期末考及發表個人報告。隨堂作業與主題報告逾期將不接受或嚴重扣分。
4.	填寫課程問卷
        需配合完成期中課程回饋（形成性評量）與期末課程調查（總結性評量），以協助課程改進與教學精進。
5.	學術誠信
        作業與報告須為個人原創，不得抄襲或冒名。尊重智慧財產權：使用他人著作、圖像、數據、原創構想與創作時，必須清楚標註來源。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1.Actively familiarize yourself with the classroom interactive tool platform, and fully express your views and participation. 
2. Please bring teaching materials and handouts to class. 
3. Eating and drinking are prohibited in the classroom to avoid affecting others. 
4. Participate on time in the final exam and present your personal report. Late submissions for in-class assignments and thematic reports will be calculated with the highest score and a passing score of 60. 
5. You are required to complete the mid-term course feedback (formative assessment) and the final course survey (summative assessment) to assist in course improvement and teaching enhancement.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.	結合理論與實務
        本課程強調室內熱環境、光環境、風環境、空氣品質的基本原理，並與實際設計案例連結。
2.	跨領域應用
        鼓勵將所學應用於建築設計、室內設計或工作場域，提升專業競爭力。
3.	主動學習
        課堂內容有標準規範，建議課後複習並善用線上資源。上課請攜帶 (手機 /平板/ 筆電 擇一 for 互動平台)，教科書課本，並記得攜帶行動電源以供不時之需。
4.	參與討論
        實務案例分享與課堂討論是重要學習環節，請積極發言並提出觀點。
5.	考試與評量
        評量方式包含課堂活動、個人報告與期末考試，請妥善規劃時間。
6.	持續關注環境議題
        室內物理環境與健康、永續、能源效率息息相關，建議多留意國際與在地的相關新聞與案例。

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學術誠信是學生在大學追求學習和學問是必要要求的行為，以確保大學學位是每位學生個人學業成就的最有力標誌。
  • 學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人行為，該次成績以零分計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎勵辦法提送。
  • 課程教材的使用請遵守智慧財產權。
  • 課程報告與成果的呈現須符合學術倫理規範。
  1. 履行自己對他人(包括師長、同儕等)的承諾。
  2. 勇於為自己的言行負責。
  3. 理解並尊重他人的意見。
  4. 當使用到他人的著作，原創構想以及創作時，務必聲明原創者。
一、引用與原創
  1. 尊重智慧財產權：使用他人著作、圖像、數據、原創構想與創作時，必須清楚標註來源。
  2. 正確引用：採用適合的引用格式（如 APA、Chicago、或課程規範指定格式）。
  3. 避免抄襲：不得直接複製他人成果，需經過理解、整理與再詮釋。
二、AI 工具使用規範
  1. AI 屬於外部資源：使用 AI（如 ChatGPT、MidJourney、GitHub Copilot 等）所生成之文字、圖片、程式或數據，應視同引用他人作品。
  2. 必須標註：於作業或報告中，清楚說明所使用的 AI 工具名稱與用途。
    • 例：「本報告部分內容經 ChatGPT（OpenAI, 2025）生成，並由作者編修確認。」
    • 例：「插圖由 MidJourney 生成，後經本人修改。」
  3. 責任歸屬：最終提交之內容，必須由學生自行審核與承擔責任，不能將錯誤或不當引用歸咎於 AI。
  4. 禁止完全依賴：AI 只能作為輔助工具，不得將未經思考或編修的 AI 產出直接當作完整成果提交。
三、學術誠信
  1. 誠實標註：如有使用 AI，應如實說明；隱匿或假稱原創者，視同抄襲。
  2. 鼓勵創新：善用 AI 作為靈感啟發或輔助工具，但應以個人獨立思考與創作為核心。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
I. Citation and Originality
  • Respect Intellectual Property Rights: When using others’ works, images, data, original ideas, or creations, the source must be clearly acknowledged.
  • Proper Citation: Adopt appropriate citation formats (e.g., APA, Chicago, or the citation style specified in the course).
  • Avoid Plagiarism: Direct copying of others’ work is prohibited; materials must be understood, organized, and reinterpreted.
II. Regulations for Using AI Tools
  • AI as an External Resource: Any text, images, code, or data generated by AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, MidJourney, GitHub Copilot) should be regarded as external sources.
  • Mandatory Acknowledgment: In assignments or reports, students must clearly state the AI tool used and its purpose.
    • Example: “Part of this report was drafted with the assistance of ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2025) and revised by the author.”
    • Example: “Figure 3 was generated by MidJourney and subsequently modified by the author.”
  • Responsibility: Students are fully responsible for the final content submitted; errors or inappropriate use cannot be attributed to AI.
  • No Over-Reliance: AI should only serve as an auxiliary tool; unedited AI outputs may not be submitted as complete work.
III. Academic Integrity
  • Honest Disclosure: If AI is used, it must be truthfully stated. Concealing or falsely claiming authorship will be treated as plagiarism.
  • Encouraging Innovation: AI may be used for inspiration and assistance, but independent thinking and original work should remain central.

  2. 必須標註：於作業或報告中，清楚說明所使用的 AI 工具名稱與用途。
    • 例：「本報告部分內容經 ChatGPT（OpenAI, 2025）生成，並由作者編修確認。」
    • 例：「插圖由 MidJourney 生成，後經本人修改。」
  3. 責任歸屬：最終提交之內容，必須由學生自行審核與承擔責任，不能將錯誤或不當引用歸咎於 AI。
  4. 禁止完全依賴：AI 只能作為輔助工具，不得將未經思考或編修的 AI 產出直接當作完整成果提交。
三、學術誠信
  1. 誠實標註：如有使用 AI，應如實說明；隱匿或假稱原創者，視同抄襲。
  2. 鼓勵創新：善用 AI 作為靈感啟發或輔助工具，但應以個人獨立思考與創作為核心。
integrity.ais_meno_en:
I. Citation and Originality
  • Respect Intellectual Property Rights: When using others’ works, images, data, original ideas, or creations, the source must be clearly acknowledged.
  • Proper Citation: Adopt appropriate citation formats (e.g., APA, Chicago, or the citation style specified in the course).
  • Avoid Plagiarism: Direct copying of others’ work is prohibited; materials must be understood, organized, and reinterpreted.
II. Regulations for Using AI Tools
  • AI as an External Resource: Any text, images, code, or data generated by AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, MidJourney, GitHub Copilot) should be regarded as external sources.
  • Mandatory Acknowledgment: In assignments or reports, students must clearly state the AI tool used and its purpose.
    • Example: “Part of this report was drafted with the assistance of ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2025) and revised by the author.”
    • Example: “Figure 3 was generated by MidJourney and subsequently modified by the author.”
  • Responsibility: Students are fully responsible for the final content submitted; errors or inappropriate use cannot be attributed to AI.
  • No Over-Reliance: AI should only serve as an auxiliary tool; unedited AI outputs may not be submitted as complete work.
III. Academic Integrity
  • Honest Disclosure: If AI is used, it must be truthfully stated. Concealing or falsely claiming authorship will be treated as plagiarism.
  • Encouraging Innovation: AI may be used for inspiration and assistance, but independent thinking and original work should remain central.

1.Actively familiarize yourself with the classroom interactive tool platform, and fully express your views and participation. 
2. Please bring teaching materials and handouts to class. 
3. Eating and drinking are prohibited in the classroom to avoid affecting others.

policy.course_rem:

        本課程強調室內熱環境、光環境、風環境、空氣品質的基本原理，並與實際設計案例連結。
2.	跨領域應用
        鼓勵將所學應用於建築設計、室內設計或工作場域，提升專業競爭力。
3.	主動學習
        課堂內容有標準規範，建議課後複習並善用線上資源。上課請攜帶 (手機 /平板/ 筆電 擇一 for 互動平台)，教科書課本，並記得攜帶行動電源以供不時之需。
4.	參與討論
        實務案例分享與課堂討論是重要學習環節，請積極發言並提出觀點。
5.	考試與評量
        評量方式包含課堂活動、個人報告與期末考試，請妥善規劃時間。
6.	持續關注環境議題
        室內物理環境與健康、永續、能源效率息息相關，建議多留意國際與在地的相關新聞與案例。
